messages:
Maya (PMM): quick pulse: want a concise webinar that teaches cost vs latency tradeoffs and includes one live demo + one prerecorded fallback. ok with that scope?
Sofia (Producer): agree. recommend 35-40m total: 8m benchmarks, 12m demo, 15m q&a, ~2m close.
Jordan (Growth): i'll run the demo. plan: show short prompt (low latency) then switch routing to show cost-optimized variant. streaming will help perception.
Ravi (AE): i'll prep two customer prompts: support triage (short) and doc-summarize (long). will upload mp4 fallback (90s) by EOD.
Liam (Ops): ops checklist: console latency graph, token meter, host phone + spare laptop, backup recorded demo accessible via gdrive. i'll spin up a spare GPU instance in ashburn.
Sofia (Producer): rehearsals: tech-check Tue 9am PT, full run Wed 11am PT. greenroom-bot: schedule reminders 24h and 30m prior.
greenroom-bot: reminders scheduled for Tue/Wed rehearsals at 24h and 30m. :white_check_mark:
Maya (PMM): action items: Maya finalize abstract + audience, Jordan demo script + embed, Ravi fallback clip, Liam ops prep, Sofia calendar + invites. target invite publish next Monday.
